$comment: Host raw writes (HidOutput::HidRaw: kind 0 output, 1 feature, data id first) a client replays on a captured Steam Controller. classic is the 2015 pad on a cable, its dongle or Bluetooth; triton is the Steam Controller 2, a Puck slot included. A classic pad takes feature frames only, report id 0 then a command in classic_forwarded. A triton feature frame's command is its first byte from 0x80, else its second; it is refused when that command is in triton_held_back. Every triton output report passes. pf-client-core sc2_capture.rs refused, Sc2Capture.swift refusedWrite and Sc2Capture.kt hostWriteRefused each check every command byte against the two lists, then the frames.
